Quote from: Luke on June 04, 2009, 03:42:21 PM
the thing is though, if they die they actually LOSE the weapons that they spent their cash on. cops don't lose anything when they die (unless they equipped something) and I think it should stay that way. sure the gangs can be overpowering but they can only have so many guns, when cops get unlimitited glocks/mp5's

Just about everyone on the server has a bind to holster they're weapon (not me because it defeats the purpose of RPing.), and if they are using anything of value,  they are wearing kevlar. And you cant head shot them with a glock and kill them. So it doesnt matter if they get unlimited glocks, anyone who is a real threat has the advantage everytime. A cop wielding a glock doesnt really have much of a chance against your super criminals, even in numbers. Which leaves to my next point.

I know the guns in the next patch are getting reworked.But does anyone else think the Shotgun is wicked overpowered? Not only does it do insane damage, even with kevlar on two or one shot from medium and close range, but it doesnt work the same way the other guns work, the recoil?
Its the only gun you can run around with because of the "pump" recoil effect and be hugely effective, where as the other guns, even setting the fire to 1 round, the recoil is so high, that you cant really move and be effective.  99% of the time if its shotgun vs anything else, you are toast. And if you do kill them, they've already put it away with there holster bind.
